steps.what: Show the stored offer on this claim.
Negotiate claim settlements or recommend litigation.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the offer already stored on the claim. The claims adjuster negotiates the settlement, or recommends litigation when settlement cannot be negotiated. The screen does not bargain and does not recommend litigation. An offer with no id leaves the negotiation with the adjuster.
tasks.previous_blocker: A claim was marked settled because an offer was on file, and nobody had negotiated.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored offer can be opened. The negotiation, and any recommendation to litigate, still belong to the adjuster.
tasks.still_hard: A position the offer does not state still has to be heard in the negotiation.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster negotiates or recommends litigation. The offer is the number already stored.
tasks.altitude: Bargaining stays with the adjuster. The stored offer is only visible.

reach.task: Hear a litigation recommendation this adjuster makes after negotiation fails.
reach.learn: An offer is not a settlement.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored offer is a lookup. It does not negotiate a settlement or recommend litigation.
Bargaining a settlement, and recommending litigation, stay with the adjuster. A screen must not do either.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The claim id and the offer already stored. The screen does not mark the claim settled or recommended for litigation. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the offer before the negotiation. Do not send a settlement or a litigation recommendation.
unknowns: Whether every claim has a stored offer before negotiation starts.
research_questions: Who may record a settlement, and only after which conversation?

already_counted.description: Negotiating the settlement or recommending litigation stays with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop offers whose claim file has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still negotiates the claim settlement, or recommends litigation when settlement cannot be negotiated. Only opening an offer that was already stored is removed. The screen does not bargain or recommend.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The claims adjuster still negotiates the settlement or recommends litigation when settlement cannot be reached. A stored offer can be opened. It does not bargain and it does not recommend.
reach: Counsel hear a litigation recommendation only after this adjuster has tried to settle.
skills_to_grow: Negotiate the settlement in the conversation.
Recommend litigation only when settlement cannot be negotiated. The screen does neither.
role.ambitious_version: Negotiation and the litigation recommendation stay with the adjuster. A stored offer only shows a number already written.
